newsitem.title: UK: Thames sees 10 pct leaks from customer pipes.
newsitem.headline: Thames sees 10 pct leaks from customer pipes.

text.p: British water and sewerage company Thames Water Plc has 10 percent of its supplies leaking from the pipes of its customers, in addition to the 20 percent which escaped from its pipes, managing director Bill Alexander told the annual meeting.
Earlier, chairman Sir Robert Clarke said that cutting leaks was a top priority for the company, which has one of the highest levels for seeping supplies in the country.
Clarke said the company would "publicise our success (in cutting leaks) not only to our shareholders but also to the world at large."
Gearing, currently running at around 40 percent, was not expected to rise much above 60-70 percent under current investment plans, another executive said in answer to a question from a shareholder.
